Gate CrossEx Skill 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- First public release of the Gate CrossEx cross-exchange trading skill
- Supports unified account management across Binance, OKX, and Gate.io, including asset transfer, order management, and position inquiry
- Provides spot, cross margin, and USDT perpetual trading
- Includes full API docs, configuration instructions, and Python/Shell usage examples
- Secure credential management with environment variables or config files
- Comprehensive error handling and official documentation links included
